Messages.Author: Talo...@hotmail.com
Messages.Body:
A player had the recent understanding that a minion could play a hand
strike, see what happened with the strike resolution, and then play
claws before/during damage resolution.

Is this true? And if so is this posted somewhere? (we looked but
could not find it)

Thanks,
T

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Talo...@hotmail.com wrote:
>
> A player had the recent understanding that a minion could play a hand
> strike, see what happened with the strike resolution, and then play
> claws before/during damage resolution.

No. Strike modifiers must be played before strike resolution.
They can be played after both minions have announced their strikes
however.
